clips.title: The story
paras: The Hunter's Way is a rite of passage offered to aspiring trackers in Mulgore by the elder Skorn Whitecloud. To prove their emerging skill and respect for the wild, wanderers must fell the cunning flatland prowlers and present their claws to Melor Stonehoof atop Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise.

For the tauren, hunting is neither mere sport nor simple subsistence; it is considered one of their people's highest honors. It demands patience, awareness of the Earth Mother's balance, and reverence for the beasts that roam the rolling plains. Elder Skorn Whitecloud, resting in Mulgore after decades of tracking across Kalimdor, recognizes this restlessness in young adventurers. Rather than allowing them to wander aimlessly, he channels their ambition into a traditional trial of maturity and discipline.

To demonstrate that their tracking instincts are genuine, candidates are tasked with taking down Mulgore's flatland prowlers. These great cats are swift, stealthy, and cunning ambush predators that blend easily into the high grass of the plains. Gathering four sets of claws proves that a fledgling wanderer can spot a predator before becoming prey, turning the hunter's own ferocity back upon them.

Upon securing the trophies, the initiate ascends the soaring wooden towers and bridges leading up to Thunder Bluff. There, upon the Hunter Rise, Melor Stonehoof receives the claws. As a master tracker who values Skorn Whitecloud's ancient wisdom, Stonehoof accepts the offering as proof that the initiate possesses the right spirit to be guided further along the predatory paths of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...
Wander, and hunt. For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.
If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path. He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.
And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young adventurer on the hunter's path.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings. There is an air about you that tells me much. Do we have business, you and I?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Skorn Whitecloud is a wise tauren. He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. We are honored to have him with us.
If Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.
Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.
